rationale: Pranav is a full-stack developer with hands-on experience building AI and web3 applications across healthcare, developer tools, and agentic systems—exactly the technical depth Darren needs as he scales KinkBNB's blockchain infrastructure and privacy-first architecture. Darren brings 30 years of e-commerce operations, web3/Ethereum expertise, and a track record of rapid prototyping, which could accelerate Pranav's applied AI work while offering mentorship on real-world infrastructure challenges Pranav hasn't yet encountered at scale.
intro_message: Pranav Patel, meet Darren Mckeeman — a serial founder scaling a web3 marketplace on Ethereum who's looking for developers comfortable with blockchain infrastructure and privacy-preserving systems, and you're building AI applications across multiple domains with Python and TypeScript.
